purpose: Independent within-cohort retraining, not transport validation of the original fitted model
reporting: Exploratory cross-dataset applicability under a fixed protocol; no post-Test selection

nhanes.label: PHQ9 >= 10; complete nine items; age >= 18
nhanes.sleep_field: SLD010H retained under its own name; never aliased to SLD012

midus.label: B1PDEPDX: supplied depressed-affect/anhedonia binary composite, not PHQ9
midus.cohort: valid binary label, valid age >= 18, SAQ participation (B1SA1 != -1)
midus.partition: 25 stratified group folds: 0-4 Test, 5-8 Cal, 9-12 Val, 13-24 Fit; approximate 48/16/16/20 percent; no family crosses partitions or internal folds
midus.survey_weights: none; do not fabricate NHANES survey weights

frozen_transport.policy: Require all original processor input fields in each cycle; no implicit aliases, all-missing field filling, retraining or external recalibration. Otherwise fail before prediction.
